prompt: Interior tavern, overhead shot of a rough map unrolled on a table between four pairs of hands, a finger pointing to a mark on it, cups pushed to the edges, lamplight
motion: The finger taps the map twice. A second hand moves a cup out of the way. The map corner curls up and is flattened again. Slow push in on the marked point.
say: The tavern keeper had a map. On it, eight miles east where the road bent around a hill, someone had drawn a small square and written one word. Sealed.
sfx: Paper on wood, cups, low voices, a fire
